limitations: Purpose semantic relations (counterparty_identity_epistemic, invoice_contract_association, commercial_dependency_status) are not persisted in 06_world/world.sqlite per P6 admission; derive_purposes.py loads their resolved tuples from 05_dispositions.json as required premises.
contract_recorded_expired and contract_obligation_kind completeness receipts are INCOMPLETE: absence of expired=false or negative obligation kinds is not closed-world asserted.
REJECT clause-presence dispositions produce no present=false tuples; acquisition-relevance derivation only fires on positive ACCEPT clause tuples.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Mechanical projection of billing status; no unresolved branch.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: COMPLETE over invoice_fields universe: every invoice with status='open' is emitted; closed invoices are omitted without asserting negation.
derivations.deterministic_computation: SELECT invoice_ref_id AS invoice_id FROM invoice_fields WHERE status = 'open'

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Positive-only expired marking; contracts without explicit past expiry or not-renewed language receive no tuple.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: INCOMPLETE over contract_document: only contracts with explicit expiry_date matching expired/not-renewed patterns are marked expired=true.
derivations.deterministic_computation: SELECT contract_id, 1 AS expired FROM contract_expiry_date WHERE expiry_date indicates past expiry or not-renewed language.
derivations.required_premise: contract_expiry_date tuple when contract source records an explicit expiry line.
derivations.optional_enrichment: contract_term_text may corroborate not-renewed language but is not required when expiry_date is explicit.
non_blocking_unresolved_state: Missing contract_expiry_date for a contract does not block active-contract derivations; absence is treated as not positively expired.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Emits obligation kind labels only for ACCEPT clause-presence tuples (present=true); REJECT and UNRESOLVED clause judgments produce no kind row.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: INCOMPLETE over contract_document: kinds emitted only where world holds present=true on a clause relation; no negative kind assertions.
derivations.deterministic_computation: UNION of contract_id with kind in {exclusivity, auto_renewal, rolling_term} from respective clause relations WHERE present = 1.
derivations.required_premise: At least one ACCEPT disposition on the corresponding clause-presence relation for the contract.
derivations.optional_enrichment: contract_document provides the contract universe for completeness receipt.
blocking_unresolved_state: UNRESOLVED exclusivity (or other obligation clause) on a contract blocks emitting that obligation kind but does not block other kinds from the same contract.
non_blocking_unresolved_state: REJECT clause-presence disposition: contract simply lacks that obligation kind without asserting a negative dependency finding.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Purpose A policy OR over acquisition-relevant clause types; relevant=true only when at least one policy-listed clause has present=true in world.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: INCOMPLETE over contract_document: contracts with no positive clause tuple are omitted rather than marked relevant=false.
derivations.deterministic_computation: For each contract, relevant=true if ANY of the five clause relations has present=true; otherwise no tuple.
derivations.required_premise: Purpose A acquisition_relevant_conditions policy mapping clause types to diligence relevance.
blocking_unresolved_state: UNRESOLVED on any single acquisition-relevant clause type blocks asserting that clause as present but does not alone block relevance if another clause type is positively present.
non_blocking_unresolved_state: REJECT clause-presence: treated as that clause type not present for relevance OR; does not assert global irrelevance.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Purpose A/C active-contract policy: expired SOWs are inactive; other contracts are active unless positively marked expired.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: INCOMPLETE over contract_document when contract_recorded_expired is incomplete: active=true is default when no expired=true tuple exists.
derivations.deterministic_computation: active=false when kind='SOW' AND contract_recorded_expired.expired=true; otherwise active=true for contracts in contract_document.
non_blocking_unresolved_state: Missing contract_recorded_expired tuple: contract treated as not positively expired, therefore active under policy unless kind=SOW with positive expiry evidence.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Include invoice when association=asserted to an active acquisition-relevant contract, or association=unresolved; omit asserted associations to inactive or non-relevant contracts without treating as negative exposure.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Coverage over invoice_fields: every invoice meeting inclusion policy appears; invoices with asserted but non-qualifying contract linkage are omitted per Purpose A scope.
derivations.deterministic_computation: JOIN invoice_fields with invoice_contract_association and contract policy relations; filter by inclusion rule; sort by invoice_id.
derivations.required_premise: invoice_contract_association semantic tuples (asserted or unresolved) from P5 dispositions.
derivations.optional_enrichment: World identity evidence relations support association premise but are not required when dispositions already resolve association.
blocking_unresolved_state: invoice_contract_association=unresolved: invoice is included with association unresolved but does not receive an asserted contract linkage row.
non_blocking_unresolved_state: UNRESOLVED acquisition-relevant clause on a contract: does not block inclusion when another clause type is positively present and association is asserted.
Missing contract_acquisition_relevant tuple: contract treated as not acquisition-relevant for inclusion filter.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Direct projection of Purpose B epistemic labels; UNRESOLVED is explicit agnosticism, not DISTINCT.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: COMPLETE over the Purpose B required_link_set emitted in P5: all connectivity links for commercially relevant relationships appear.
derivations.deterministic_computation: SELECT left, right, epistemic FROM counterparty_identity_epistemic ORDER BY left, right.
derivations.required_premise: counterparty_identity_epistemic semantic tuples from P5 dispositions.
derivations.optional_enrichment: World mechanical identity relations ground SAME_ENTITY premises cited in disposition packets.
non_blocking_unresolved_state: UNRESOLVED epistemic on a link pair: emitted as UNRESOLVED; does not block other links in the graph.
DISTINCT on registry candidates: emitted as DISTINCT; does not imply global merge prohibition failure.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Assemble dependency rows from commercial_dependency_status; status=dependent requires resolved identity and both policy tests; status=unresolved preserves agnosticism when identity blocks the join.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Coverage per Purpose C: each counterparty-contract pair with dependent or unresolved outcome from commercial_dependency_status is materialized with open invoice ids and obligation kinds.
derivations.deterministic_computation: For each commercial_dependency_status tuple, collect open invoice_ids for the counterparty billing identifier and obligation_kinds from contract_obligation_kind; serialize sorted lists; sort entries by contract_id.
derivations.required_premise: commercial_dependency_status semantic tuples from P5 dispositions.
derivations.optional_enrichment: counterparty_identity_epistemic UNRESOLVED pairs explain unresolved dependency deferrals; contract_obligation_kind supplies sorted obligation_kinds.
blocking_unresolved_state: UNRESOLVED counterparty_identity_epistemic between invoice billed name and contract counterparty forces commercial_dependency_status=unresolved, blocking dependent classification.
UNRESOLVED obligation clause on a contract blocks that obligation kind in obligation_kinds but may not block dependent if another kind is positively present and identity is resolved.
non_blocking_unresolved_state: UNRESOLVED registry candidate links for Northbridge: do not block dependent status when billing-to-contract identity is SAME_ENTITY.
Expired contract exclusion: pairs on expired SOW without active relationship are omitted from output rather than listed as unresolved.
